Subject: Re: Unusual mid-cycle invoice & VAT allocation (Feb period)

Hi Amelia / team — I pulled the usage snapshots and ran a quick audit against our ingestion logs. Summary below; full CSV attached.

Summary findings (preliminary):
- Gross invoiced (Feb 28): EUR 921,325.00
- Disputed delta (Feb 20–25 window): EUR 18,347.50 (approx. 2.0% of gross) — rooted in a short-lived replay from a staging stream that included prefetched requests with intact KV cache, which resulted in additional embed units being counted.
- Root cause: a reprocessor job (internal job id rp-20270222-77) re-enqueued a batch for 8 hours when a transient upstream webhook retried; our bucketing/aggregation window, which groups requests into 1-minute metering windows, double-counted those prefetched requests when the trace lacked a dedupe header.

What I’ve attached: usage_snapshot.csv — per-request rows for Feb 20–25 with request_id, timestamp, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, session_id, meter_bucket.

Proposed remediation (options):
A) One-time credit covering the disputed amount (EUR 18,347.50) + issue a corrected invoice with adjusted VAT lines.
B) If TickTrade prefers a partial offset against next cycle we can apply the credit and produce a VAT adjustment certificate (credit note) for your tax filing.

VAT note: the invoice included VAT at 20% (EUR 184,265.00 on the gross). If we issue a credit note, Redwood will also produce a VAT-corrected credit note that includes the reverse-entry for the VAT portion so your finance team can reclaim / adjust as required. Please confirm which option you prefer.

Attachment: usage_snapshot.csv (CSV, 54KB)

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success — Billing Ops, Redwood Inference

2) For bookkeeping we need the corrected invoice with the same invoice number schema (or a clear mapping) so our AP team can close the payment hold quickly. Can you confirm ETA for the corrected invoice / credit note?

3) On the payment side — if we accept a credit and apply it to the next cycle, can we also get a signed payment plan confirming Redwood will hold collection on the disputed portion until the credit is posted? If so please send a DocuSign link.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

— Amelia

Hi Amelia — following the investigation, this is the resolution from Redwood. Apologies again for the disruption.

What we found (short): a replay from a staging reprocessor (rp-20270222-77) caused duplicate-prefetch rows to be counted during the Feb 20–25 windows; our metering dedupe header was missing for those requests and they were bucketed separately. Vanessa’s snapshot (attached in prior message) contains the request_ids that were counted twice.

Resolution agreed:
- Redwood will issue a one-time credit in the amount of EUR 18,347.50 to TickTrade Inc. (credit reduces gross invoice to EUR 902,977.50).
- We will issue a VAT-corrected credit note and a corrected invoice mapping to the original invoice number (INV-20270228-RT). The corrected invoice and credit note will be posted to your portal and a copy sent to finance@ticktrade.com by end of business on Mon 2027-03-08.
- If TickTrade has already remitted VAT for the disputed portion, Redwood will provide a VAT adjustment certificate / credit note that you can use for reclaim; we will also offer reasonable support to your tax advisor if required.
- Collection: Redwood will pause collection on the disputed EUR 18,347.50 while the crediting process completes. To formalize the collection hold and next-cycle application of credit, please sign the attached payment plan. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/HT-8792 (DocuSign link included in the ticket).

Attachments included: signed_payment_plan.pdf (agreement stub — once we have your signature we'll lock the collection entry).

If that reads correctly, we’ll proceed to issue the credit note and corrected invoice tomorrow and confirm by email. Thanks for working with us on a tight timeline.

Best,
